description: Batch-runs a set of questions against a published Data Agent and reports each answer. An evaluation PRIMITIVE, not a judge: it runs the questions (optionally several times with --repeats) and emits the answers. When a question carries an `expected` answer, fabio adds a naive string-match signal (match.exact / match.contains) — it deliberately does NOT do semantic/LLM grading, leaving that to the calling agent.

match.note: naive string comparison (case/whitespace-insensitive); not semantic grading

results.question: What is 2+2? Reply with just the number.

notes: Questions file is JSON (an array of strings, or of {"question","expected"} objects) or CSV/TSV with a `question` column and optional `expected` column. Each question runs on its own throwaway thread (independent). --repeats N runs each question N times (answers is an array). --show-steps includes the SQL/tool-call run steps per run. Only a published agent is queryable (same rules as `query`); the published URL is auto-constructed unless --published-url is given. The command fails only if EVERY run errors; otherwise partial results are returned with failedRuns > 0.

query_examples.description: How many individual runs errored (0 = all succeeded).
